scripts.make-pot: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/blockendar wp-content/plugins/blockendar/languages/blockendar.pot --slug=blockendar --domain=blockendar --exclude=node_modules,vendor,build,lib,tests,bin,plans,demo-plugin --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"https://github.com/philhoyt/Blockendar/issues","Language-Team":"philhoyt <https://github.com/philhoyt/Blockendar>"}' --allow-root
scripts.make-json: node bin/i18n-map.js && wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/blockendar/languages --no-purge --use-map=wp-content/plugins/blockendar/languages/.i18n-map.json --allow-root
scripts.make-translations: npm run make-pot && npm run make-json
